proposals.evidence: DEDR2124 explicitly gives Konda kuṟveli rainbow and Kannada koraḍu/koḍḍa a kind of rainbow. The survey kuruveli/karuḍu responses match their respective language comparanda, preserving epenthetic/reduced-vowel notation and the survey’s broader rainbow gloss. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2160 explicitly gives Parji korr cock/hen/fowl, Gadaba kor/korru cock, Gondi kor/korr fowl/hen and Konda koṟu hen. The selected simple survey kor/koru chicken forms match those language-specific comparanda, preserving final vowels and singleton notation. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2468 explicitly gives Konda sāmbu (plural sāpku) thorn, with Gadaba sāpu/sappu and Gondi sāp/hāp comparanda. Survey sāmpu and sāmu match the Konda nasal cluster, with devoicing or loss of the stop; these are stated survey variants rather than exact quotations. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3538 gives Tamil tōkai tail, Malayalam tōka, Kannada tōke, Gondi tōkār/tōkor/tōkar/tōka and Konda tōka tail. Selected simple survey tok-/tōk- responses match this family, retaining gemination and lect-specific final vowels. Gondi teke and other more divergent responses remain unassigned. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR4764 gives Gondi marrī/mari/marr son and Konda maṟin/maṟisi son (the latter referring to third person). Survey mar/maru and marisi/marsi retain these stems and the Konda relational ending, including syncope; ordinary inflection is not treated as derivation. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
